item.title: Master Timeboxing for Job Search Efficiency ⏱️ • Set specific goals for each search session. • Block 1-2 hours daily in your calendar. • Prioritize tasks: applications, networking, research. • Review and adjust time blocks weekly for improvement. How can you optimize your calendar to boost your job search productivity? #productivity #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
